device.type: Handheld DVB-S2 + DVB-T2 + DVB-C combo signal meter and spectrum analyser with built-in TFT LCD
device.board: 17010000 (bootloader version "M3516F 1.2.1", 16 MB SPI flash, 256 MB DDR3 M3503/M3516F handheld meter platform)
device.soc: ALi M3516F / M3503 with 256 MB DDR3 (bootloader "M3516F 1.2.1", seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xAE000200; Libcore 13.9.0@SDK4.0fa.13.9_20150511, Application 1.0.0@SDK4.0fa.13.6_20141203)
device.demod: ALi S3501 / internal DVB-S2 + Availink AVL6862 DVB-T2/C/S2

panel.chip: CH455 keypad and indicator LED controller (TM1650-compatible; bootloader writes " ON ", application drives indicator LEDs 0x64/0x66 and scans keypad)

source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO_XFinder_Plus_1.0.33_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as a 256 MB DDR3 M3503 / M3516F board on a 16 MB SPI flash (chips/m3503.py, chip word 0x35030001 for M3503 revision B, run_dump_xfinder_plus_app_starts.py, run_dump_xfinder_plus_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader runs with its stack in the cache-as-RAM window at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF, drives CH455 on SCL = GPIO 135 / SDA = GPIO 134 ("CH455 panel init OK!", " ON "), sets 0xB8000220 bit 24 to remap physical 0x0F000000..0x0FFFFFFF to the top 16 MB of DDR, parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA141A7DC, unpacks 2.96 MB seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xAE000200 and 10.46 MB maincode(AV) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x8E002001).  In maincode, PAN_CH455_0 blanks the 7-segment digits ("    "), drives the meter's status LEDs at CH455 registers 0x64 / 0x66, and polls the keypad matrix on GPIO 135 / 134 (tm1650_decoder.py), exchanges 1,900+ SEE RPC calls, prints "ali play 1.0 $$$" and "nim_avl6862_set_lnb_power=1", and renders its 1280x720 CLUT8 OSD through GeM36F / GMA layer 0 (without the handheld unit's hardware-ID IC it displays the 17010000 hardware-ID notice).

desc: Firmware 1.0.33 emu (2018-05-02) for the Amiko X-Finder+ handheld DVB-S2 / DVB-T2 / DVB-C signal meter and spectrum analyser with built-in TFT LCD, built on the ALi M3516F / M3503 SoC with 256 MB DDR3 and 16 MB SPI flash.

Uses the M3516F XIP bootloader ("CH455 panel init OK!" on GPIO 135 / 134) followed by a 10.46 MB handheld-meter application whose PAN_CH455_0 driver controls the meter's indicator LEDs and scans its keypad matrix on GPIO 135 / 134.
